dehydrated_text:
"When you make the two one, and when you make the inside like the outside, and the outside like the inside, and the above like the below, and when you make the male and the female one and the same, so that the male not be male, nor the female. And when you fashion eyes in the place of an eye, a hand in place of a hand, and a foot in place of a foot, and a likeness in place of a likeness, then will enter the kingdom."

Okay. But once we develop our imagination and recognize that this world is just a projection of our imagination, it allows us to take control over it and access the vine. We can see fashioning eyes where there were none, hands where they should not be, and feet in their place. This enables us to become our true selves. And we will understand that we are all connected by this vine. The separation of male and female, Chinese, American, black, white— it's all made up. Once we see reality as it is, we'll all be one.

When you make the two one, make the inside like the outside and the outside like the inside, and the above like the below. We are all interconnected and part of the same source. We must train ourselves to see the truth from this falsehood. This idea is about asha moving towards interconnectedness, harmony, and the division of things.

His disciples said to him, "Show us a place where you are since it is necessary for us to seek it." He said to them, "Whoever has ears, let him hear. There is light within the man of light and he lights up the whole world. If he does not shine, he is darkness."

The disciples ask Jesus how to be like him. Jesus says, "Be yourself. There's a light inside of you." Look for that light and shine it on the world.

Jesus said, "I took my place in the midst of the world and appeared to them in flesh. I found all of them intoxicated but none thirsty. My soul became afflicted for the sons of men because they are blind in their hearts and do not have sight. For empty they came into the world and empty too they seek to live, but for the moment they are intoxicated. When they shake off their wine, then they will repent."

Jesus said, "If the flesh came into being because of spirit it is a wonder. But if spirit came into being because of the body it is a wonder of wonders. Indeed, I am amazed at how this great wealth has made its home in poverty." We came into this world with nothing and when we die, we go back with nothing. This pursuit of materialism, wealth, power makes no sense. You are here pursuing all this stuff, gold, wealth, money that you can't take with you. It seems as though you're drunk.

The flesh coming into being because of spirit is a wonder. The idea is that the consciousness, mind creates the material world. If you think the body creates the spirit, you're crazy. It's impossible. It's a wonder of wonders. Because the spirit is full of wealth and the body is impoverished. How is it possible that an impoverished body can create so much wealth? Our minds are vast, abundant, but our bodies are limited. So how is it possible that our smaller brains create a universe of ideas and experiences?

The idea of being intoxicated yet not thirsty for the truth mirrors Roomie's poem.
